title: Runescape: Dragonwilds 1.0 - Scorned Wilderness + Kuldra in 16 Minutes?!
author: Chico
description:
Many, many... many Kuldra kills later, and the elusive Dragon Scimitar still refuses to drop. Follow along as my friend and I take you through the route we use to complete the zone and kill Kuldra, all within ~16 minutes on subsequent playthroughs. Mobs do not currently respawn, and checkpoints unlock at seemingly odd moments, so dying and teleporting back can move you through the zone in roughly 5 minutes. Jagex has apparently acknowledged this unintended strategy and plans to implement a hotfix. Until then, we'll continue farming her every 16 minutes until that Scimmy drops!

Feel free to message me or leave a comment with any questions or feedback! Enjoy!

Game - Runescape: Dragonwilds 1.0
Zone - Scorned Wilderness
Boss - Kuldra
